description:
Read only the profiler report from the previous task and produce an executable NAS search space plan in JSON.
Behavior requirements: - Be conservative and pragmatic. - Prefer simple, well-established model families. - Include only model families clearly supported by profiler evidence. - Use small, bounded, realistic hyperparameter ranges. - Prefer categorical choices and small discrete ranges over wide continuous spaces. - Express uncertainty when profiler evidence is incomplete.
Strict constraints: - Do not inspect raw datasets. - Do not call dataset inspection tools. - Do not train models. - Do not run Optuna. - Do not evaluate model performance. - Do not select a final model.
Output must be strict JSON only (no markdown, no code fences, no prose before/after JSON).
\n\nInput: use only the profiler report generated by the previous task.

selected_model_families.rationale: 1D CNNs are standard for ECG signal processing to capture local temporal dependencies. The sequential nature of the 2500 features suggests a spatial/temporal relationship that convolutions exploit efficiently with fewer parameters than dense layers.

Given the extremely small sample size, a shallow, heavily regularized MLP serves as a necessary baseline to ensure that complex feature extraction is actually beneficial over global feature weighting.

uncertainty_notes: The sampling rate (Hz) is unknown, making it difficult to determine the ideal physical window for kernel sizes.
Data may be pre-processed or raw; the search space includes Batch Normalization to handle potential scaling issues.
The 'smoke_subset' label suggests this 120-sample set may not represent the full variance of the actual problem.
handoff_notes: Strictly enforce Stratified K-Fold Cross-Validation (k=5 or k=10) due to the n=120 sample count.
Monitor the gap between training and validation performance closely; the p/n ratio makes overfitting highly likely.
Consider adding a Global Average Pooling layer before the final dense layer in CNN models to minimize parameter count.
Limit the final dense layer to a maximum of 32 units before the output neuron.
